name: Augur Canis On-Demand Suite
description: Triggers an on-demand AC contract test suite via the gateway admin route and verifies the trigger is accepted. Confirms that the gateway correctly proxies admin commands to Augur Canis and that AC's on-demand suite mechanism is operational. The suite itself runs asynchronously — this plot tests the trigger path, not the suite results.
author: seti
